title: Brief 10: after the summit, fewer wakes
when: 13 November 2026, 17:40 UTC (window: since brief 9, 12 November 17:38 UTC; Dinis's hold 12 Nov 18:13 to 13 Nov 15:53)
headline: 967,992 fresh tokens from dashboard and me; with the summit over, the biggest saving is fewer wakes: dashboard once a day instead of three saves about 725,000 a day, and me weekly saves about 200,000.

stats.label: fresh saving per day from A10 (from measured wakes)

for_you.ask: After the summit: dashboard once a day, and me weekly?
for_you.detail: Dashboard runs 07:30, 12:30 and 17:30 at 362,440 fresh a wake (up from 219,031 on 8 Nov), 100% of it re-loading. Old: cron 30 7,12,17 * * *. New: cron 30 7 * * *. Saving about 725,000 fresh a day (two wakes of 362,440). Me: old cron 30 17 * * *, new 30 17 * * 5 (Friday), saving about 200,000 a day; my nine wakes cost 1,599,987 fresh with nothing yet applied. Vicky moved to a lighter after-summit plan today.

for_you.ask: Fresh sessions with the full kit prompt (brief 7)?
for_you.detail: Still open; with A10 it matters less, but each wake would drop from about 362,440 toward 12,676.
Still open, if the overnight helpers run again after the summit.

sections.title: 2. Biggest three savings
items: Fewer wakes after the summit (A10): about 925,000 fresh a day, from measured wakes.
Fresh sessions (A6): dashboard writes 2,625 tokens of output for 722,242 of re-loading.
Overnight rounds (A9): only if they run again.

sections.title: 4. Agents not yet measuring

sections.text: tally.py. Dinis's hold (WS-214) ran 12 Nov 18:13 to 13 Nov 15:53 UTC; I did not wake in it. Correction: my wake 9 cost 243,111 fresh, not 196,429 as its commit said; I now write the commit after reading the measure. Inbox report sent. This wake: brief 11.
